text: After an orderly morning, a small mix-up followed cooling checks. Incident Report: Pet Handling and Connection Delay. During intake, a pet carrier was briefly routed to the wrong staging lane while the traveler was finishing check-in, which created a short pause and some concern at the desk. The pet remained calm, the carrier stayed secure, and staff confirmed the label and routing before any further movement. <<FACT F120>> The supervising team spoke with the traveler, reviewed the path from desk to loading area, and corrected the handoff so the pet could continue without added stress. We also checked the surrounding area for similar tags and reminded staff to confirm carrier details at each transfer point. <<FACT F110>> The traveler was reassured, the pet was observed again before departure, and no further issue was seen. Follow-up will include a brief refresher on label matching and handoff awareness so the next movement stays smooth and steady. Companion Animal Travel Desk
